newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai police arrest two tourists on drug charges.
newsitem.headline: Thai police arrest two tourists on drug charges.

text.p: Thai narcotics police have separately arrested two tourists -- one from Hong Kong and the other from Poland -- and charged them with possession of heroin and marijuana, customs officials said on Saturday.
Lee Wai Ming, 31, from Hong Kong was arrested on Friday with 4.2 kg (9.3 lb) of heroin at Bangkok International Airport when he was about to board a flight to Frankfurt, the officials said.
The drug which was hidden in his two overcoats could fetch $3.2 million in Europe, they said.

Separately, Andrzej Grabowski, 41, from Poland was arrested at the same airport on Friday when he was about to leave for Amsterdam after the police found six kg (13.3 lb) of marijuana wrapped around his body.
The marijuana was smuggled from Nepal and worth around five million baht ($190,000), the official said.
The maximum penalty for heroin trafficking in Thailand is death by firing squad but the sentence is typically commuted to a lengthy prison term.
